entities.summary: Widukind of Corvey was a medieval Saxon chronicler and a monk of monastery of Corvey in Germany during the middle third of the 10th century. His three-volume Res gestae Saxonicae sive annalium libri tres is an important chronicle of 10th-century Germany during the rule of the Ottonian dynasty.
